ShortDescription.Value: Customize starting money and milestones, add simple budget tools, and optionally charge network demolition costs.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Budget + Milestones
Set up your city the way you want — normal start, harder start, or a quick head start.
#### City Start - Keep normal milestone progression or start at a milestone you choose. - Set starting money for the next limited-money city. - Keep normal milestone cash rewards or turn the cash bonuses off. - Optional network demolition cost from 0% to 50%.
#### Budget Tools - Add or subtract a chosen amount with hotkeys. - Optional Auto Add Money can keep your balance above a selected threshold.
#### Unlimited Money Converter - Convert an Unlimited Money save to normal limited-money budgeting. - Make a backup first. The mod cannot undo the conversion.
**Vanilla-friendly defaults:** no milestone skip, normal milestone rewards, and 0% demolition cost.
No Harmony patch.
